## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE

**1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS**
All styling lives in `style.css`. The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML. All design properties, layout rules, and states are targeted exclusively via class or ID selectors. HTML stays semantic and style-agnostic — retheming the site must require editing only `style.css`, never the markup.

**1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens**
Define every token in `:root` (and re-map under the dark theme): all palette tokens from the Brief, plus `--radius-sm: 4px`, `--radius-md: 10px`, `--radius-lg: 20px`, `--shadow-sm: 0 1px 3px rgba(43,33,24,0.15)`, `--shadow-md: 0 6px 18px rgba(43,33,24,0.25)`, `--spacing-gap: 1.5rem`, `--transition-fast: 150ms`, `--transition-normal: 300ms`, `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)`, `--z-dropdown: 1000`, `--z-modal: 1050`, `--z-toast: 1100`. Every light background token must pair with a dark text token and vice versa — enforce this pairing in every theme, not only the default.

**1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode**
Define dark tokens under both `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and a `.dark` class. Implement a "torch-lit tomb" variant: `--bg-primary: #1B150C`, `--bg-secondary: #261D10`, `--text-primary: #EFE3C3`, `--text-secondary: #C7B58E`, gold stays `#FFD700` (luminous), lapis lightens to `#6FA0DC` for text-level use, turquoise brightens to `#2FC0C4`, carnelian brightens to `#E05252` for error text, borders `#3A2F1D`, deeper shadows. Background and text variables must switch seamlessly with zero HTML restructuring. Persist the user's choice via `localStorage`, falling back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit, with a visible toggle control carrying correct `aria-pressed` and `aria-label` state. **Exception clause:** the source style spec listed dark mode as not required; dark mode remains mandatory under this architecture and must ship as the torch-lit tomb variant above.

**1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment**
Build all layout structures with Flexbox. Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless an explicitly justified exception is documented in a CSS comment. All flex layouts are mobile-responsive out of the box — rows convert to columns on smaller viewports. Horizontal scrolling is prohibited anywhere on the page. Use fluid `clamp()` typography and spacing.

**1.5 Framework Default & Tailwind CSS Integration**
Use Tailwind CSS (CDN or build) for layout utilities only (flex, grid, spacing, responsive breakpoints). All thematic and component styling lives in `style.css` as reusable BEM classes (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`) mapped to the CSS variables. Never hardcode hex values in utility classes; never bypass the variable system with inline Tailwind color utilities.

**1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)**
Load via `<link>` with `preconnect` and `display=swap`: Cinzel Decorative, Cinzel, EB Garamond, Noto Sans Egyptian Hieroglyphs, and Google Material Symbols. Raw inline SVGs, local icon files, and emoji icons are forbidden. All decorative art must be CSS-constructed: pyramid and obelisk silhouettes via `clip-path` polygons, sun discs via radial gradients, hieroglyphic bands and aged papyrus grain via layered `repeating-linear-gradient`/`radial-gradient` textures and pseudo-elements. Hieroglyph strips use Noto Sans Egyptian Hieroglyphs characters with `aria-hidden="true"` and are purely decorative — never carry meaning.

## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

**2.1 Button Component**
`.btn` base: `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum touch target 44×44px. Variants: `.btn--primary` (lapis background, papyrus-light text), `.btn--gold` (gold background, ink text — hero and final CTA), `.btn--ghost` (transparent, gold border), `.btn--danger` (carnelian background, light text — visually distinct in both themes). Style all states via CSS classes: **Hover** — brightness/shadow shift with `cursor: pointer`. **Focus** — distinct gold focus ring via `outline`/`box-shadow` using CSS variables for keyboard navigation. **Active** — `transform: scale(0.97)` click feedback. **Loading** (`.is-loading`) — disables interactions, prevents double-clicks, renders a CSS border-spinner or animated Material Symbol without distorting button dimensions. **Disabled** — `opacity: 0.5`, greyscale, `cursor: not-allowed`. **Success/Error** (`.is-success` / `.is-error`) — temporary feedback tinted by `--text-success` / `--text-error`, announced to assistive tech.

**2.2 Card Component**
`.card`: flexible Flexbox layout, `--bg-secondary` surface, `--border-default` border, `--radius-md`, `--shadow-sm`. **Hover** (interactive cards only): `transform: translateY(-2px)` plus `--shadow-md` elevation shift. **Focus-within**: gold border highlight when any child link/button receives focus. **Loading skeleton** (`.card--skeleton`): shimmer animation via a sweeping linear-gradient, with reserved dimensions to prevent layout jumps. **Empty state** (`.card--empty`): structured fallback with a Material Symbol and clear guidance text. Feature cards place their Material Symbol icon inside a gold cartouche ring.

**2.3 Form & Input Requirements**
`.input-group`: flex column wrapping a `<label>`, the input field, and a dedicated error feedback container. Account for all states: empty, focused (gold outline ring), filled, valid (`--border-success` + check Material Symbol), invalid (`--border-error`, red text, error icon, `aria-invalid`, `aria-describedby`), disabled, and read-only. Error messages render inside an `aria-live="polite"` container. If a newsletter signup is included in the footer or final CTA, it must implement this full specification.

**2.4 Modal / Popup Requirements**
No modals are required for this page; however, if any overlay is introduced it must cover: opening, open, loading, success/error, and closing states — all animated via CSS transitions. Centered flex container (`align-items: center`), backdrop overlay, Material Symbol close button, keyboard focus trapping, and close via `Esc` or overlay click, layered at `--z-modal`.

## 3. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES

- **Responsive by Default:** Fluid sizing and breakpoints with zero horizontal overflow at any viewport width.
- **Smooth Animations:** `transition: var(--transition-normal)` on all state changes; fully respect `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` by disabling transforms, shimmer, parallax, and entrance motion.
- **Accessibility (a11y):** WCAG AA contrast in both light and dark modes. Never rely on color alone to communicate state — pair icons and text with every state color. Semantic HTML5 elements (`header`, `nav`, `main`, `section`, `article`, `footer`), correct ARIA roles/labels on custom widgets (theme toggle, accordion), logical DOM/focus order, full keyboard operability, and `aria-live` regions for dynamic feedback (form errors, toasts, loading states).
- **Mandatory Visual Feedback:** Every click, hover, and submission triggers a visible state change.
- **Destructive Actions:** `.btn--danger` must be visually distinct in both light and dark themes.
- **Scrolling:** Smooth anchor scrolling (disabled under reduced motion); sticky header with a subtle backdrop.
